prContext.title: Add TS transformer for schema inference
prContext.description: TypeScript compiler plugin that infers Zod schemas from types.
prContext.instructions: Review for correctness and compiler API usage.

groundTruth.description: Type checker is obtained via inline comment placeholder — actual implementation likely creates a new Program/TypeChecker per call, which is extremely expensive (seconds per call). Should reuse the existing Program from the transformer context.
tsTypeToZod only handles string and number — unions, arrays, objects, enums, and literals all fall through to z.unknown(), producing incorrect schemas.
No caching of inferred schemas — same type inferred repeatedly in large codebases, causing O(n^2) behavior. Should memoize by type ID.
Returns string literals like z.string() instead of actual Zod objects — the consumer must eval() or parse these strings, which is unsafe.

reviewer_comments.what: Creating a type checker per call is extremely expensive.
reviewer_comments.why: TypeScript type checking is the most expensive operation. Reusing the existing checker is critical.

reviewer_comments.what: Only string and number are handled. Unions, arrays, and objects will silently produce z.unknown().
reviewer_comments.why: This defeats the purpose of schema inference for complex types.
